veranderings.voor: Droë hout is hard en dit bly hard
veranderings.na: Droë hout is hard, en dit bly hard
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Hard materiaal gee nie mee
veranderings.na: Harde materiaal gee nie mee
veranderings.rede: Attributive adjective takes the -e ending (harde materiaal); the block itself already writes 'Sagte materiaal'.

veranderings.voor: Sag materiaal gee mee
veranderings.na: Sagte materiaal gee mee
veranderings.rede: Attributive adjective is inflected (sagte materiaal), as the last sentence of the same block already has it.

veranderings.voor: Styf materiaal hou sy eie vorm

veranderings.voor: Sterk materiaal hou heel wanneer
veranderings.na: Sterk materiaal bly heel wanneer
veranderings.rede: The idiom is 'heel bly', as the lesson says everywhere else; 'heel hou' is unidiomatic.

veranderings.voor: Die baksteen trek jou hand af en die hout
veranderings.na: Die baksteen trek jou hand ondertoe, en die hout
veranderings.rede: 'trek jou hand af' can read as 'pull your hand off'; 'ondertoe' gives the direction at no word cost, plus the AWS comma between two clauses.

veranderings.voor: Die druppel loop by die buitekant af en die emmer
veranderings.na: Die druppel loop aan die buitekant af, en die emmer
veranderings.rede: Water runs 'aan' the outside ('aan die buitekant af', as the glass block says), plus the AWS comma between two clauses.

veranderings.na: 'n Gebakte baksteen suig ook water in, en tog bly hy hard
veranderings.rede: 'suig ook water in' is the natural order for 'also absorbs water', plus the AWS comma between two clauses.

veranderings.voor: eienskappe gelyk
veranderings.na: eienskappe tegelyk
veranderings.rede: 'tegelyk' is the standard word for 'at the same time'; 'gelyk' also means 'equal' or 'level'.

vlae.teks: Daardie plank is bloot groter en hy vertel jou niks oor die materiaal nie.
vlae.rede: 'hy' refers to the plank, but the point is that its heavier weight says nothing about the material; 'sy gewig' would be clearer but adds a word, so a writer should decide.

vlae.teks: 'n Dun plastieksak buig net so maklik in jou vuis.
vlae.rede: A bag squeezed in a fist crumples rather than bends; the image may not show bending clearly, but changing it means choosing new content.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In 'Buigbaar materiaal gaan krom' the adjective is attributive and should be inflected ('Buigbare materiaal'), like harde, sagte, stywe, waterdigte and absorberende. This keeps the protected word choice (not rekbaar or buigsaam) but changes its form, so a person should decide.
